lanes.name: Backoffice / Privileged Staff
lanes.hint: Configure and publish notifications and bulk notes

nodes.label: Submit Agent ID & Password
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to submit Agent ID and password to log in to the system.

nodes.label: Role-Based View Rendered
nodes.desc: The System shall provide role-based view; views are enabled or disabled based on the role matrix.

nodes.label: Initiate Profile Edit
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to initiate agent profile edit from the profile section, where role permits.

nodes.label: Forgot Password
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to initiate the forgotten password flow.

nodes.label: Verify Identity (Authcode/OTP)
nodes.desc: As part of the forgot-password flow, the agent shall be able to verify himself by providing the necessary details (Authcode or OTP) before proceeding to create a new password.

nodes.label: Create New Password
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to create the new password as per password policy. A non-compliant or mismatched entry is rejected in place with a validation message (agent re-enters the password on the same step).

nodes.label: Change Password
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change password by providing current password, new password, and confirm password.

nodes.label: Verify Identity for Password Change
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to identify himself for change password by providing necessary details (Authcode or OTP). Invalid or expired details prevent the change and re-prompt on the same step with a validation message.

nodes.label: Update MFA Settings
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change MFA settings with privileges.

nodes.label: Verify Identity for MFA Settings
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to identify himself for MFA Settings by providing necessary details (Authcode or OTP). Invalid or expired details prevent the change and re-prompt on the same step with a validation message.

nodes.label: Change Language
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change language from available options.

nodes.label: Save Profile Changes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to save profile changes.

nodes.label: Profile Changes Saved
nodes.desc: Agent Profile status model: Edit Initiated -> Saved.

nodes.label: View Eligible Entities
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to navigate to view entities for which access is available.

nodes.label: Choose Entity Type
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to choose the entity type before export.

nodes.label: Export Visible Entities
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to export all visible entity records such as Orders, and Tickets.

nodes.label: Configure Bell Notification
nodes.desc: The Backoffice role shall be able to configure bell icon notification against a customer using the defined template and expiry date.

nodes.label: Publish Notification Manually
nodes.desc: The privileged Agent shall be able to publish bell icon notifications manually using a defined format.

nodes.label: View Bell Banner
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the bell icon notification as a banner across Customer 360 screens.

nodes.label: Customer-Specific Notification Visibility
nodes.desc: The System shall display only customer account or MSISDN-specific notifications based on access permissions.

nodes.label: Sort Notifications
nodes.desc: The System shall sort customer notifications from latest to oldest.

nodes.label: No Manual Expiration
nodes.desc: The agent shall not be able to expire the bell icon notification manually.

nodes.label: Expire Notification
nodes.desc: The System shall remove bell icon notification after the preconfigured expiration interval.

nodes.label: Configure Bulk Notes
nodes.desc: The Backoffice role shall be able to configure bulk notes using a defined template.

nodes.label: Apply Note to Multiple Accounts
nodes.desc: The System shall allow the same bulk note to be applied to multiple customer accounts.

nodes.label: View Bulk Notes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view multiple notes pushed by the system with posting date and time.

nodes.label: Bulk Note Visibility Maintained
nodes.desc: The System shall display bulk notes irrespective of timeline after posting.

nodes.label: View Task Dashboard
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view task dashboard categories including Open Tasks, In Progress Tasks, Pending Payments, Priority Tasks, and Draft Orders.

nodes.label: Display Assigned Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall display assigned tasks and priority tasks only for the logged-in agent.

nodes.label: Categorize Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall categorize tasks based on priority and open task rules.

nodes.label: Supervisor Assigns Task
nodes.desc: The System shall allow only the supervisor to assign tasks to team members.

nodes.label: Navigate to Task Detail
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to navigate to detailed task view by selecting Open Tasks.

nodes.label: Update Task Status
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to move task status to In-progress or Close.

nodes.label: Task Closed
nodes.desc: Task status model: Open -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Closed.

nodes.label: Maintain Approval Matrix
nodes.desc: The System shall maintain a configured approval matrix for each task category.

nodes.label: View Assigned Approval Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall display all approval tasks assigned to the specific agent.

nodes.label: Open Detailed Task View
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the detailed view of the task by opening the task.

nodes.label: View Task History
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to see task history before confirming Approval, Rejection, or Return.

nodes.label: Approve / Reject / Return
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to approve, reject, or return an approval task.

nodes.label: Add Approval Notes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to add notes for approval task status Approved, Rejected, or Returned.

nodes.label: Approval Task Approved
nodes.desc: Approval Task status model: Pending Approval -> Approved.

nodes.label: Approval Task Rejected
nodes.desc: Approval Task status model: Pending Approval -> Rejected.

agents.Name: Journey and Session Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Journey initiation, agent authorisation, Qnomy queue and ticketing, automatic tracking record creation, milestone persistence and draft order resume

agents.Name: Agent Profile Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Manage the changes in the agent profile by changing the password, MFA settings and language

agents.Name: Bell Icon Notification
agents.Purpose / Feature: Configure, publish, view, sort, and expire customer account/MSISDN notifications.

agents.Name: Bulk Notes
agents.Purpose / Feature: View and publish notes applicable to one or multiple customer accounts.

agents.Name: Agent Task View
agents.Purpose / Feature: View assigned tasks by open, in progress, pending payment, priority, and draft orders; navigate to task detail and update status.

agents.Name: Agent Approval View
agents.Purpose / Feature: View assigned approval tasks, approve, reject, return with notes, and see task history.

agents.Name: Agent Level Entity Export
agents.Purpose / Feature: View eligible entities, select an entity type, and export all visible records such as Orders and Tickets

contracts.RuleStatement: Only agents granted profile-edit authority may update profile information, and they are accountable for the accuracy of the changes they submit.
An agent may request an MFA change only after identity verification and within the privileges approved by VFQ Security.
Only designated Backoffice or privileged staff may create or publish bell icon notifications and bulk notes.
Staff publishing bell icon notifications or bulk notes must use an approved template and confirm the applicable customer or account context and expiry before publication.
Only the responsible supervisor may assign or reassign tasks to members of the supervisor's team.
Only the assigned approver may approve, reject, or return an approval task; rejection or return must include the applicable reason and supporting notes.

login_submit.title: Submit Agent ID & Password
login_submit.does: The agent submits Agent ID and password to log in.
login_submit.example: AGN-001-JSM-01: The agent can submit Agent ID and password to log in to the system.

role_view.title: Role-Based View Rendered
role_view.does: System renders Agent 360 views enabled/disabled per the role matrix.
role_view.example: AGN-001-APM-01: Views are enabled or disabled based on the role matrix.

profile_edit_initiate.title: Initiate Profile Edit
profile_edit_initiate.does: Agent opens the profile edit option from the profile section.
profile_edit_initiate.example: AGN-001-APM-05: Edit profile option is available to the agent where role permits.

forgot_password.title: Forgot Password
forgot_password.does: Agent initiates the forgotten password flow.
forgot_password.makes: Password-reset session directed to identity verification
forgot_password.example: AGN-001-APM-02: Forgot password directs the agent to password setup and supports the confirmed identification step.

identify_password.title: Verify Identity (Authcode/OTP)
identify_password.does: Agent identity is verified via Authcode or OTP before password reset can continue.
identify_password.makes: Verified identity, or rejection with validation message
identify_password.example: AGN-001-APM-03: Agent identity is successfully verified only when the required Authcode or OTP is valid; invalid or expired details are rejected with an appropriate validation message.

create_new_password.title: Create New Password
create_new_password.does: Agent sets a new password conforming to password policy.
create_new_password.needs: New password, confirmation value, password policy
create_new_password.makes: Accepted new password, or a validation message on failure
create_new_password.example: AGN-001-APM-04: A new password is accepted only when it complies with the configured password policy and matches the confirmation value; otherwise, a clear validation message is displayed.

change_password.title: Change Password
change_password.does: Agent changes password by providing current, new, and confirm password.
change_password.needs: Current password, new password, confirm password, successful login
change_password.example: AGN-001-APM-06: Password change is accepted only after successful login and after password policy validation.

identify_change_password.title: Verify Identity for Password Change
identify_change_password.does: Agent identity is verified via Authcode or OTP before the change-password action proceeds.
identify_change_password.makes: Verified identity, or a validation message preventing the change
identify_change_password.example: AGN-001-APM-07: The agent can proceed to Password Change only after successful verification using a valid Authcode or OTP; invalid or expired details prevent the change and display an appropriate validation message.

update_mfa.title: Update MFA Settings
update_mfa.example: AGN-001-APM-08: MFA status and authenticator/OTP setting can be updated only when permitted by role and security policy.

identify_mfa.title: Verify Identity for MFA Settings
identify_mfa.does: Agent identity is verified via Authcode or OTP before the MFA-settings change proceeds.
identify_mfa.makes: Verified identity, or a validation message preventing the change
identify_mfa.example: AGN-001-APM-07A: The agent can proceed to change MFA settings only after successful verification using a valid Authcode or OTP; invalid or expired details prevent the change and display an appropriate validation message.

change_language.title: Change Language
change_language.does: Agent switches interface language from available options.
change_language.example: AGN-001-APM-09: English and/or Arabic options are available subject to VFQ confirmation.

save_profile.title: Save Profile Changes
save_profile.does: System validates and saves the agent's profile changes.
save_profile.makes: Persisted profile changes, or a rejection with validation message
save_profile.example: AGN-001-APM-10: Valid profile changes are saved and invalid changes are rejected with validation message.

profile_saved.title: Profile Changes Saved
profile_saved.does: Profile changes are persisted; profile status moves to Saved.
profile_saved.example: Status_Model: Agent Profile / Saved — Profile changes are saved. Trigger: Agent saves valid profile changes.

view_eligible_entities.title: View Eligible Entities
view_eligible_entities.does: Agent navigates to view entities available under their access rights.
view_eligible_entities.makes: Entity list scoped to access rights
view_eligible_entities.example: AGN-001-AEX-01: Entity list displays as per access rights.

choose_entity_type.title: Choose Entity Type
choose_entity_type.does: Agent selects the entity type (Order, Ticket) before exporting.
choose_entity_type.example: AGN-001-AEX-03: Entity type values include Order, Ticket until VFQ confirms the complete list.

export_entities.title: Export Visible Entities
export_entities.does: Agent exports all visible entity records of the chosen type.
export_entities.needs: Selected entity type, visible entity records
export_entities.example: AGN-001-AEX-02: Export can be generated for visible entities irrespective of whether they are assigned to the logged-in agent.

configure_bell.title: Configure Bell Notification
configure_bell.does: Backoffice configures a bell icon notification against a customer using an approved template and expiry date.
configure_bell.needs: Permitted role, template, customer/account context, expiry date
configure_bell.example: AGN-001-BIN-01: Bell notification can be configured only by the permitted role.

publish_bell.title: Publish Notification Manually
publish_bell.does: Privileged staff publish the bell notification, created from a stored template and editable before publishing.
publish_bell.example: AGN-001-BIN-02: Notification can be created from a stored template and edited before publishing.

view_bell_banner.title: View Bell Banner
view_bell_banner.does: Agent views the bell icon notification as a banner across Customer 360 screens.
view_bell_banner.example: AGN-001-BIN-03: Notification banner is visible on Customer 360 for applicable account/MSISDN.

bell_visibility.title: Customer-Specific Notification Visibility
bell_visibility.does: System restricts displayed notifications to the accessible customer account/MSISDN context.
bell_visibility.example: AGN-001-BIN-04: Agent can view notifications only for accessible customer account/MSISDN context.

sort_bell.title: Sort Notifications
sort_bell.does: System sorts notifications from latest to oldest.
sort_bell.example: AGN-001-BIN-05: Notifications display in descending chronological order.

no_manual_expire.title: No Manual Expiration
no_manual_expire.does: System blocks any manual-expire action by the agent; notification stays visible until its configured expiry.
no_manual_expire.example: AGN-001-BIN-06: No manual expire action is available to the agent; the bell icon notification remains visible until the configured expiry date or interval is reached, after which it is removed automatically.

expire_bell.title: Expire Notification
expire_bell.does: System automatically removes the notification after its configured expiry interval.
expire_bell.example: AGN-001-BIN-07: Expired notification is no longer displayed after expiry rules are met.

configure_bulk_notes.title: Configure Bulk Notes
configure_bulk_notes.does: A permitted Backoffice user creates/configures a bulk note from an approved template.
configure_bulk_notes.example: AGN-001-BNT-04: Only a permitted Backoffice user can create or configure a bulk note using an approved template; users without the required role cannot access or submit the configuration.

apply_bulk_note.title: Apply Note to Multiple Accounts
apply_bulk_note.does: System applies the same bulk note across one or more customer accounts.
apply_bulk_note.makes: Bulk note associated with target accounts (Status: Posted)
apply_bulk_note.example: AGN-001-BNT-02: A bulk note can be associated with one or more customer accounts.

view_bulk_notes.title: View Bulk Notes
view_bulk_notes.does: Agent views posted bulk notes with their posting date/time.
view_bulk_notes.example: AGN-001-BNT-01: Bulk notes display with associated date and time.

bulk_note_posted.title: Bulk Note Visibility Maintained
bulk_note_posted.does: System keeps posted bulk notes visible regardless of elapsed time (until a confirmed expiry rule exists).
bulk_note_posted.example: AGN-001-BNT-03: Posted bulk notes remain visible unless business confirms an expiry rule.

view_task_dashboard.title: View Task Dashboard
view_task_dashboard.does: Agent views the task dashboard across all task categories.
view_task_dashboard.example: AGN-001-ATV-01: Dashboard shows all task categories.

display_assigned_tasks.title: Display Assigned Tasks
display_assigned_tasks.does: System filters the dashboard to tasks assigned/prioritised for the logged-in agent only.
display_assigned_tasks.example: AGN-001-ATV-02: Logged-in agent sees only task records permitted for that agent.

categorize_tasks.title: Categorize Tasks
categorize_tasks.does: System places each task into the correct category using configured priority/open-task rules.
categorize_tasks.example: AGN-001-ATV-05: Task appears in the correct category after business rules are configured.

supervisor_assign_task.title: Supervisor Assigns Task
supervisor_assign_task.does: Only the responsible supervisor assigns/reassigns tasks to team members.
supervisor_assign_task.example: AGN-001-ATV-03: Non-supervisor users cannot assign tasks to team members.

navigate_task_detail.title: Navigate to Task Detail
navigate_task_detail.does: Agent opens the detailed task view by selecting an Open Task.
navigate_task_detail.example: AGN-001-ATV-04: Selecting a task opens the task detail page.

update_task_status.title: Update Task Status
update_task_status.does: Agent moves the task status to In-Progress or Closed.
update_task_status.needs: Task detail view, permitted lifecycle transition
update_task_status.example: AGN-001-ATV-06: Task status can be updated only through permitted lifecycle transitions.

task_closed.title: Task Closed
task_closed.does: Task reaches the terminal Closed status.
task_closed.example: Status_Model: Task / Closed — Agent closes task. Trigger: Agent status update.

approval_matrix.title: Maintain Approval Matrix
approval_matrix.does: System maintains the configured approval matrix governing approval task assignment.
approval_matrix.makes: Approval matrix used to route approval tasks
approval_matrix.example: AGN-001-AAV-01: Approval task assignment follows configured approval matrix.

view_assigned_approvals.title: View Assigned Approval Tasks
view_assigned_approvals.does: Agent sees all approval tasks assigned to them (Status: Pending Approval).
view_assigned_approvals.example: AGN-001-AAV-02: Approval view shows tasks assigned to the logged-in agent.

view_task_detail_approval.title: Open Detailed Task View
view_task_detail_approval.does: Agent opens the detail view of an assigned approval task; access is denied if the task isn't assigned/accessible.
view_task_detail_approval.makes: Task detail view with all configured fields, or access-denied outcome
view_task_detail_approval.example: AGN-001-AAV-02A: When the agent selects and opens an assigned approval task, the system displays the task detail view with all configured fields for that task; if the task is not assigned or accessible to the agent, access is denied.

view_task_history.title: View Task History
view_task_history.does: Agent reviews task history before confirming an approval decision.
view_task_history.makes: Displayed task history (Task ID, Task Name, Action Taken, Date/Time)
view_task_history.example: AGN-001-AAV-05: Task history displays Task ID, Task Name, Action Taken, and Date Time Stamp.

approve_reject_return.title: Approve / Reject / Return
approve_reject_return.does: Only the assigned approver approves, rejects, or returns the approval task.
approve_reject_return.example: AGN-001-AAV-03: Approval action updates task status as per workflow and records notes where required.

add_approval_notes.title: Add Approval Notes
add_approval_notes.does: Agent records notes with the approval action; rejection/return must include reason and supporting notes.
add_approval_notes.makes: Approval notes captured with the action; a Returned task cycles back to Pending Approval
add_approval_notes.example: AGN-001-AAV-04: Approval notes are captured with the approval action.

approval_approved.title: Approval Task Approved
approval_approved.does: Approval task reaches terminal Approved status.
approval_approved.example: Status_Model: Approval Task / Approved — Approval task is approved. Trigger: Approver selects approve.

approval_rejected.title: Approval Task Rejected
approval_rejected.does: Approval task reaches terminal Rejected status, with reason/notes recorded.
approval_rejected.example: Status_Model: Approval Task / Rejected — Approval task is rejected with reason/notes. Trigger: Approver selects reject.

contractPlain.BR-01: Only agents with profile-edit authority may update profile info, and they own the accuracy of what they submit.
contractPlain.BR-02: An agent can only request an MFA change after identity verification and within VFQ Security's approved privileges.
contractPlain.BR-03: Only designated Backoffice or privileged staff can create or publish bell icon notifications and bulk notes.
contractPlain.BR-04: Notifications and bulk notes must use an approved template and confirm the right customer/account context and expiry before publishing.
contractPlain.BR-05: Only the responsible supervisor can assign or reassign tasks within their team.
contractPlain.BR-06: Only the assigned approver can approve, reject, or return an approval task; reject/return needs a reason and supporting notes.
